issues: Recharts logs 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on first mount — the ResponsiveContainer parent has no explicit min-height until data loads. Consider wrapping in a fixed-height div (e.g. h-56) or setting minHeight on ResponsiveContainer to silence the warning and avoid a brief 0-size flash.

action_items: Optional: fix Recharts responsive-container initial 0x0 warning by giving mood-trend-card chart a stable min height.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1330 lines; journal + chat + integrations + reminders + weekly recap all live in one module. Consider splitting into routers (auth, chat, journal, tasks, todos, integrations, background_jobs).

chat_stream: when payload.conv_id is set and action=='info_request' with prior_messages, kb_context is intentionally skipped. If the user changes scope mid-thread, the scope=all context won't be re-fetched on later turns — acceptable behavior but worth documenting.

retrieve_kb embeds non-kb candidates (tasks/todos/journal) on the fly on every scope=all query with no cache. For heavy users this is O(N) per request. Consider persisting embeddings on task/todo/journal insert (same pattern already used for kb_chunks).

GET /api/journal uses `$regex` with user-supplied `q` unescaped — a specially crafted `q` (e.g. '(a+)+') can trigger ReDoS on large corpora. Escape or wrap with `re.escape` server-side before building the regex.
seed_data_creation: 1 task 'Riunione con dentista Rossi' (due 2030-04-15) + several journal entries created via /api/chat/stream action='journal' during tests. Not auto-cleaned; all scoped to the disposable test user above.
